body: ACCEPT AS AMENDED. Under the stated anti-dither rule I find no remaining constructible-invalid, required-unrepresentable, scientific-conflation, or identity/reproducibility defect in C1-T plus A-F after the two accepted repairs. The controlling dependency sequence must be explicit in the superseding post: exact D2 V8 plus accepted B0-C specification/oracle identity -> C1-T; accepted C1-T plus P1 closure plus aggregate B0 closure -> C1-A; A through F sequential; the generic C1-C implementation must pass the exact B0-C provider-free mapping oracle on JVM/JS/Native; only F plus that evidence closes aggregate C1. The matrix must include every declared public/package-visible factory including unsafe-named paths, apply, copy, companion fromProduct, and Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct, with a same-mechanism positive control for each refusal. Honest Cartesian records may document an open door; invariant-bearing values must close it or route through checked construction. With those accepted amendments incorporated, promote only C1-T next.
